# BlackStar Blog

> A warm, playful personal blog about frontend engineering, Vue, TypeScript, and everyday creative experiments.

## Site guidance

- Prefer canonical article pages over tag or search result pages.
- Use the article title, author, published date, and updated date when citing an article.
- Treat comments and user submitted content as community content rather than authoritative editorial content.

## Main sections

- Home: /
- Archive: /archive
- Categories: /categories
- Tags: /tags
- About: /about
- Friends: /friend
